name: Apples
description: Crisp and juicy Red Delicious apples, perfect for a healthy snack or baking.

name: Bananas
description: Sweet, organic bananas, a great source of potassium and energy.

name: Oranges
description: Sweet and tangy oranges, packed with Vitamin C. Great for juicing or eating whole.

name: Grapes
description: Seedless green grapes that are crisp, sweet, and incredibly refreshing.

name: Strawberries
description: Juicy and sweet strawberries, ideal for snacking and decorating.

name: Pineapple
description: Juicy and tangy pineapple, great for a tropical treat or to add to savory dishes.

name: Watermelon
description: Refreshing and hydrating watermelon, a perfect treat for a hot day.

name: Mangoes
description: Sweet and succulent mangoes, perfect for smoothies and desserts.

name: Cherries
description: Sweet and juicy red cherries, excellent for snacking or as a garnish.

name: Dragon Fruit
description: A visually stunning fruit with a mildly sweet flavor, often described as a mix between a pear and a kiwi.

name: Persimmon
description: A wrinkly, purple fruit with a tangy and sweet pulp full of edible seeds.

name: Blue Berries
description: A small, round fruit with a red, textured rind and a sweet, fragrant, and slightly floral white flesh.

name: Kiwi
description: A nutrient-dense fruit with a unique sweet and tart flavor and vibrant green flesh with small black seeds.

name: Guava
description: A tropical fruit with a sweet taste, a strong scent, and a pink or white pulp with small seeds.

name: Custard Apple
description: A beautiful fruit with a distinctive five-point shape when sliced. It has a slightly sour flavor.

name: Pomegranate
description: An ancient fruit with a hard exterior and hundreds of juicy, gem-like arils filled with sweet and tart juice.

name: Figs
description: A soft, pear-shaped fruit with a sweet, jam-like texture and a unique flavor.

name: Rambutan
description: A fruit with a hairy, red exterior and a sweet, translucent flesh similar to lychee.

name: Lychee
description: Known as the 'king of fruits,' it has a pungent odor and a creamy, rich texture.

name: Almonds
description: Crunchy and nutrient-rich almonds, perfect for snacking or as a healthy addition to meals.

name: Walnuts
description: Heart-healthy walnuts with a rich, earthy flavor. Great for baking or as a topping for salads.

name: Cashews
description: Creamy cashews with a delicate flavor, perfect for snacking and adding to curries.

name: Pistachios
description: Salty and delicious pistachios, a satisfying snack with a distinct green hue.

name: Dried Apricots
description: Sweet and chewy dried apricots, a great source of fiber and vitamin A.

name: Raisins
description: Naturally sweet dried grapes, perfect for baking or a quick energy boost.

name: Dates
description: Sweet, chewy dates, a natural sweetener and a great source of iron and potassium.

name: Dried Figs
description: Soft and sweet dried figs, a classic dry fruit with a jam-like texture.

name: Dried Cranberries
description: Tart and tangy dried cranberries, a perfect addition to trail mix and baked goods.

name: Hazelnuts
description: Nutty and aromatic hazelnuts, often used in desserts and confections.

name: Onions
description: A foundational ingredient in most Indian curries and gravies, providing a pungent and savory base.

name: Tomatoes
description: Adds a tangy and slightly sweet flavor to a variety of dishes, from curries to salads.

name: Potatoes
description: A versatile and widely-used vegetable, forming the base of many popular dishes like aloo gobi and aloo mutter.

name: Cauliflower
description: Known for its tender florets, it is a key ingredient in 'Gobi Paratha' and the classic 'Aloo Gobi' dish.

name: Cabbage
description: A crunchy vegetable used in stir-fries, curries, and salads. It is also the main ingredient in 'Patta Gobhi Ki Sabzi'.

name: Spinach
description: A leafy green vegetable, a rich source of iron. It is used to make dishes like 'Palak Paneer' and 'Saag'.

name: Lady's Finger (Okra)
description: A beloved vegetable in Indian cuisine, used to prepare 'Bhindi Masala' and other dry curries.

name: Bitter Gourd
description: Known for its distinct bitter taste, it is a healthy vegetable often used in stir-fries and pickles.

name: Carrots
description: A vibrant and sweet vegetable, commonly used in 'Gajar Ka Halwa', curries, and salads.

name: Radish
description: A Radish has a crunchy texture and a slightly peppery flavor. Add flavors to you 'Parathas' and salads.

name: Capsicum (Bell Pepper)
description: Adds a mild, sweet flavor and vibrant color to dishes. It is a key ingredient in 'Capsicum Fry' and 'Paneer Chilli'.

name: Zucchini
description: A versatile vegetable, popular for its mild flavor and high water content. It's often used in stir-fries, salads, and as a substitute for noodles.

name: Broccoli
description: A nutrient-rich vegetable with dense, green florets. It is often steamed or stir-fried and is a popular addition to many healthy dishes.

name: Red Bell Peppers
description: Sweet and vibrant, these bell peppers add color and flavor to stir-fries, salads, and roasted vegetable platters.

name: Yellow Bell Peppers
description: Known for their mild, sweet taste, yellow bell peppers are a popular choice for salads, sandwiches, and for stuffing with a variety of fillings.

name: Mushrooms
description: Earthy and savory, mushrooms add a unique texture and a rich, umami flavor to a variety of curries, stir-fries, and biryanis.

name: Lettuce
description: A crisp and fresh leafy green, commonly used in salads and sandwiches to add a light, crunchy texture.

name: Asparagus
description: Delicate and earthy, asparagus spears are typically blanched or roasted and served as a side dish or in salads.

name: Celery
description: A crunchy vegetable with a distinct savory flavor, often used in soups, stews, and as a raw snack with dips.

name: Cherry Tomatoes
description: Small and sweet, these tomatoes are perfect for adding a burst of flavor to salads, pasta dishes, and skewers.

name: Baby Corn
description: Small, tender, and sweet, baby corn adds a delicate crunch to stir-fries, salads, and soups.

name: Wheat
description: A staple grain used to make flour for daily rotis, chapatis, and various baked goods.

name: Rice
description: The most widely consumed grain in India, serving as a primary accompaniment to curries, dals, and vegetables.

name: Bajra
description: Also known as pearl millet, it is a highly nutritious grain often used to make rotis, especially in the winter.

name: Jowar
description: Sorghum grain is a popular gluten-free alternative used to make flatbreads (rotlas) and is known for its health benefits.

name: Maize
description: Corn is used for various purposes, including making flour for 'Makki ki Roti' and as a sweet vegetable.

name: Ragi
description: Finger millet, a nutrient-dense grain popular in southern India, is used to make porridge, rotis, and dosas.

name: Barley
description: A fiber-rich grain often used in soups, stews, and as a healthy breakfast option.

name: Oats
description: A versatile grain, commonly used for making healthy breakfast porridge and a popular ingredient in many baked goods.

name: Quinoa
description: While not a traditional Indian grain, it has become increasingly popular due to its high protein content and versatility in salads and rice dishes.

name: Semolina (Suji)
description: Also known as suji, this coarse flour is used to prepare popular Indian dishes like upma, rava dosa, and halwa.

name: Toor Dal
description: Also known as split pigeon peas, Toor Dal is a staple in Indian households, commonly used to prepare sambar and dal fry.

name: Masoor Dal
description: Red lentils that are easy to cook and absorb flavors well. They are often used in simple, comforting dal preparations.

name: Moong Dal
description: Split yellow lentils with a soft, creamy texture. Moong Dal is highly digestible and is used for both savory and sweet dishes like halwa.

name: Urad Dal
description: Also known as black gram, it is used to make a variety of dishes including dal makhani, dosas, and idlis.

name: Chana Dal
description: Split chickpeas with a nutty flavor. Chana Dal is a good source of protein and is used in curries, snacks, and sweets.

name: Chickpeas (Kabuli Chana)
description: Also known as Kabuli Chana, these versatile chickpeas are a key ingredient in popular dishes like Chole Bhature.

name: Kidney Beans (Rajma)
description: A staple in North Indian cuisine, Rajma are a hearty bean used to prepare a rich and flavorful curry.

name: Black-Eyed Peas (Lobia)
description: Known for their mild flavor and creamy texture, Lobia is used in curries, salads, and lentil fritters.

name: Dried Peas (Matar)
description: Dried peas are commonly used to make delicious street food like 'matar chaat' and hearty curries.

name: Green Gram (Moong Whole)
description: A versatile whole lentil used for sprouting, making 'chilas' (pancakes), and delicious curries.

name: Black Gram (Urad Whole)
description: Used to make a variety of dishes including dal makhani, dosas, and idlis.

name: Pigeon Pea (Arhar)
description: The whole form of pigeon peas, a cornerstone of Indian vegetarian cooking, used in a variety of regional dals.

name: Soybeans
description: Soybeans are highly nutritious and versatile, used for making tofu, soy milk, and in various vegetarian dishes.

name: Peanuts (Groundnuts)
description: A popular snack and ingredient, peanuts are used in curries, chutneys, and groundnut oil production.

name: Wheat Flour (Atta)
description: The most common flour in India, used to make soft and fluffy rotis, parathas, and pooris.

name: Chickpea Flour (Besan)
description: Used widely for making popular snacks like pakoras, bhajis, and for preparing a variety of curries and sweets.

name: Rice Flour (Chawal ka Atta)
description: Used to make crisp dosas, idlis, and a variety of snacks. It's also used as a thickening agent.

name: Corn Flour (Makki ka Atta)
description: A staple in North Indian cuisine, used to make Makki ki Roti, a flatbread often paired with Sarson ka Saag.

name: Sorghum Flour (Jowar Atta)
description: A gluten-free flour used to make rotis, especially in Maharashtra and Karnataka. It's rich in fiber and protein.

name: Finger Millet Flour (Ragi Atta)
description: Known for its high calcium and iron content, Ragi flour is used to make rotis, dosas, and baby food.

name: Millte Flour (Bajri ka Atta)
description: A nutritious flour used in combination with other flours to make rotis and for porridges.

name: Gram Flour (Sattu)
description: Roasted chickpea flour, a popular high-protein food in Bihar and other parts of India, used for drinks and savory dishes.

name: Multigrain Flour
description: A nutient rich flour.

name: Water Chestnut Flour (Singhada Atta)
description: Used during religious fasts in India, this flour is used to make rotis and halwa.

name: Tata Tea
description: One of India's most recognized tea brands, Tata Tea is a household name known for its rich taste and strong, brisk flavor.

name: Brooke Bond Red Label
description: As one of the largest-selling tea brands in India, Red Label is celebrated for its balanced flavor and rich color, making it a staple for many.

name: Wagh Bakri Tea
description: Known for its consistent quality and robust, full-bodied flavor, Wagh Bakri is a popular choice, especially in Western India.

name: Lipton
description: Globally recognized, Lipton has a strong presence in India, with its green tea variants being particularly popular among health-conscious consumers.

name: Taj Mahal Tea
description: This premium brand is known for its exquisite aroma and taste, often enjoyed on special occasions and by those who appreciate a fine blend.

name: Nescafé
description: A globally recognized brand and a household name in India, Nescafé is a leader in the instant coffee segment, known for its convenience and wide range of products like Classic, Gold, and Sunrise.

name: Bru
description: Owned by Hindustan Unilever, Bru is one of India's most popular coffee brands. It has a strong presence with both instant coffee and traditional chicory-blended filter coffee powder.

name: Tata Coffee
description: A major Indian producer with its own plantations, Tata Coffee offers a diverse range of products, from instant coffee to premium single-origin beans, with a focus on quality and sustainability.

name: Blue Tokai Coffee Roasters
description: As a leader in India's specialty coffee movement, Blue Tokai is highly popular among connoisseurs, offering a wide variety of freshly roasted, single-origin coffee beans and ground coffee.

name: Continental Coffee
description: A prominent Indian brand known for its wide range of instant, filter, and freeze-dried coffees. Continental Coffee caters to both retail consumers and the hospitality industry.

name: Madhur
description: A popular and trusted brand in India, known for its hygienic, refined, and sulphur-free sugar. It is a flagship brand of Shree Renuka Sugars.

name: Fortune
description: From Adani Wilmar, Fortune is a well-known brand that offers a variety of high-quality, refined and sulphur-free sugars, trusted for its purity and hygiene.

name: Whole Farm
description: Focusing on natural and indigenous sweeteners, Dhampur Green is known for its range of products including sulphur-free sugar, jaggery (gur), and desi khand.

name: Organic Tatva
description: Part of the trusted Tata Group, Tata Sampann offers a range of everyday kitchen staples, including high-quality crystal sugar that adheres to strict purity standards.

name: Amul Sugar
description: Known for its commitment to quality and health, Uttam Sugar produces a variety of sulphur-free sugars, including powdered and demerara options.

name: Sugar Free
description: The most dominant and widely recognized brand for sugar-free sweeteners in India, with variants like Sugar Free Gold (Aspartame) and Sugar Free Green (Stevia).

name: Sugar Free Stevia
description: Specializing in Stevia-based sweeteners, Zindagi Stevia offers a natural, zero-calorie alternative that is popular with health-conscious consumers and diabetics.

name: I'm Lite
description: A globally recognized brand, Equal is a common sugar substitute found in Indian supermarkets and cafes, typically using Aspartame.

name: Cumin Seeds (Jeera)
description: A staple in almost every Indian kitchen, with a warm, earthy, and smoky flavor. It is often tempered in hot oil at the beginning of a dish to release its aroma.

name: Coriander Seeds (Sabut Dhania)
description: The dried seeds of the coriander plant, with a mild, citrusy, and nutty flavor. They are a core ingredient in many spice blends and are often roasted and ground.

name: Mustard Seeds (Sarson/Rai)
description: Small, round seeds that pop when tempered in hot oil, releasing a pungent, nutty flavor. They are widely used in South Indian cuisine and pickles.

name: Fenugreek Seeds (Methi Dana)
description: Small, yellowish seeds with a slightly bitter and nutty taste. Used in small quantities in pickles and spice blends, they are also known for their digestive properties.

name: Green Cardamom (Hari Elaichi)
description: Known as the 'Queen of Spices,' it has a sweet, floral, and aromatic flavor. It is used whole in both sweet dishes and savory preparations like biryani.

name: Cloves (Laung)
description: Dried flower buds with a strong, pungent, and sweet aroma. A potent spice used in small amounts to flavor rice dishes and meat curries.

name: Black Peppercorns (Kali Mirch)
description: Native to India, these offer a sharp, pungent heat. They are used whole to add a distinct depth of flavor to biryani and various curries.

name: Cinnamon Stick (Dalchini)
description: The bark of the cinnamon tree, with a warm, sweet, and woody aroma. Used whole in rice dishes and curries, and is a key ingredient in Garam Masala.

name: Bay Leaves (Tej Patta)
description: Used for their aromatic qualities, they have a subtle, earthy, and sweet aroma. They are typically added to stews, curries, and rice dishes like biryani and removed before serving.

name: Star Anise (Chakra Phool)
description: This star-shaped spice has a strong licorice-like flavor. It is a staple in Mughlai cuisine and is used in various spice blends.

name: Turmeric Powder (Haldi)
description: A vibrant yellow powder known for its earthy, slightly bitter flavor and anti-inflammatory properties. It is a cornerstone of Indian cooking, adding color and health benefits to almost every dish.

name: Red Chili Powder (Lal Mirch)
description: Provides the spicy heat and color to Indian cuisine. It is available in various grades of pungency, from mild Kashmiri chili to the fiery hot Guntur chili.

name: Coriander Powder (Dhaniya Powder)
description: Made from ground coriander seeds, it is a versatile spice with a mild, earthy, and citrusy flavor. It provides a base flavor for many curries and gravies.

name: Cumin Powder (Jeera Powder)
description: Ground from roasted cumin seeds, it has a warm, earthy flavor. It is a key ingredient in many dishes and spice blends, and is also used for its digestive benefits.

name: Garam Masala
description: A quintessential Indian spice blend. The mix typically includes cinnamon, cardamom, cloves, cumin, coriander, and black pepper, adding warmth and depth to dishes.

name: Black Pepper Powder (Kali Mirch Powder)
description: Provides a pungent, sharp heat. It is a common seasoning and is used to add a quick punch of spice to soups, salads, and various dishes.

name: Amchur Powder (Dry Mango Powder)
description: Made from sun-dried green mangoes, this powder is a souring agent. It adds a tangy, fruity flavor to curries, chutneys, and savory snacks like chaat.

name: Asafoetida (Hing)
description: A dried resin with an extremely pungent aroma in its raw form, which mellows to a smooth, onion-garlic flavor when cooked. A tiny pinch is used as a flavor base in many lentil and vegetable dishes.

name: Dry Ginger Powder (Sonth)
description: Ground from dried ginger root, it has a strong, pungent, and slightly sweet flavor. It is used in curries, marinades, and in spice blends for its unique taste and health benefits.

name: Dry Fenugreek Leaves (Kasuri Methi)
description: Dried fenugreek leaves that have a rich, slightly bitter, and aromatic flavor. A pinch of these leaves, crushed between the palms, adds a distinct fragrance to curries and breads.

name: Saffron (Kesar)
description: The world's most expensive spice, made from the stigma of the saffron crocus flower. It imparts a beautiful golden color, a subtle flavor, and a luxurious aroma to sweet dishes and biryani.

name: Mace (Javitri)
description: The dried, crimson-colored outer covering of the nutmeg seed. It has a delicate, sweet, and warm flavor, more subtle than nutmeg, and is used in fine spice blends and biryani.

name: Black Cardamom (Badi Elaichi)
description: Larger than its green counterpart, this spice has a smoky, camphor-like flavor. It is a powerful spice used in savory dishes, meat curries, and biryanis for a deep, musky aroma.

name: Nutmeg (Jaiphal)
description: A hard, aromatic seed with a warm, nutty flavor. It is used in small quantities, often grated, in both sweet dishes, rich gravies, and some spice blends.

name: Chilli Flakes
description: Chilli flakes are crushed dried red chili peppers, used to add a touch of spicy heat and vibrant color to dishes.

name: Oregano Herbs
description: Oregano is an aromatic herb from the mint family, with a warm, earthy, and slightly bitter flavor, widely used in Italian, Greek, and other Mediterranean cuisines.

name: Sunflower Oil
description: A light and neutral-flavored oil with a high smoke point, making it a versatile choice for a wide range of everyday Indian dishes, from deep-frying to sautéing.

name: Mustard Oil (Sarson ka Tel)
description: Known for its pungent flavor and strong aroma, this oil is a staple in Northern and Eastern Indian cuisine, particularly for curries, stir-fries, and pickles.

name: Groundnut Oil (Peanut Oil)
description: Popular in Western and Southern India, this oil has a mild, nutty flavor and a high smoke point, making it ideal for deep-frying and stir-frying.

name: Coconut Oil
description: A cornerstone of South Indian and coastal cuisine, known for its distinct aroma and flavor. It is widely used in curries, tempering, and in dishes where its unique taste is desired.

name: Ghee (Clarified Butter)
description: A traditional Indian cooking fat with a rich, nutty flavor and high smoke point. It is used for tempering, frying, and is a key ingredient for many sweets and rich gravies.

name: Sesame Oil (Til Oil)
description: A staple in many Southern Indian states, with a distinct, nutty flavor. It is excellent for tempering, sautéing, and adding a finishing touch to dishes.

name: Soybean Oil
description: A neutral-flavored, affordable oil with a high smoke point, making it a popular choice for all kinds of cooking, from frying to baking.

name: Rice Bran Oil
description: Known for its high smoke point and light, neutral flavor. It is gaining popularity due to its perceived health benefits and is suitable for all types of cooking, including deep-frying.

name: Canola Oil
description: With a light flavor and low saturated fat content, canola oil is considered a healthier option and is versatile for various Indian cooking methods.

name: Extra Virgin Olive Oil
description: A premium oil from Italy and Spain, gaining popularity for its health benefits. It is best used for dressings, light sautéing, and drizzling over finished dishes as its flavor is delicate and it has a low smoke point.

name: Avocado Oil
description: Known for its high smoke point and buttery flavor, avocado oil is a versatile option for high-heat cooking, grilling, and salad dressings.

name: Flaxseed Oil (Alsi ka Tel)
description: A rich source of Omega-3 fatty acids, this oil has a nutty flavor and is not suitable for cooking due to its low smoke point. It is best used raw in salads, smoothies, or as a supplement.

name: Walnut Oil
description: A flavorful and expensive oil with a distinct nutty taste. It is not ideal for high-heat cooking and is best used for salad dressings, baking, or to add a gourmet touch to dishes.

name: Hemp Seed Oil
description: Known for its rich omega fatty acid content and subtle, nutty flavor. It is not suitable for cooking and is used primarily in dressings, dips, and cold preparations for its health benefits.

name: Lay's India's Magic Masala
description: A very popular potato chip flavor in India, offering a zesty and spicy mix of local spices and herbs that appeals to the Indian palate. It's a signature product from the Lay's brand.

name: Uncle Chipps Plain Salted
description: A classic and nostalgic brand of potato chips in India, known for its simple, no-fuss salted flavor. It is a legacy brand often associated with a reliable and homely taste.

name: Bingo! Mad Angles
description: Known for their unique triangular shape, these crisps offer a satisfying crunch and a variety of bold, spicy flavors like 'Achaari Masti,' catering to a younger audience.

name: Balaji Wafers Masala
description: A very popular homegrown brand, these thin, crispy potato wafers are known for their distinct and intense masala seasoning. They are a staple in many Indian households.

name: Parle's Wafers
description: From the makers of the iconic Parle-G biscuit, Parle's Wafers are a well-known and widely available brand of potato chips, often favored for their affordability and classic flavors.

name: Pringles Desi Masala Tadka
description: Pringles' Indian-inspired flavor, offering a unique 'desi' twist to their classic stackable crisps. It combines the familiar Pringles shape with the spicy and tangy flavors of Indian cuisine.

name: Kurkure Masala Munch
description: A staple in Indian households, these crunchy and tangy corn puffs are known for their unique 'Tedha Hai Par Mera Hai' tagline and a spicy, 'chatpata' flavor.

name: Banana Chips
description: A popular South Indian snack, these thin and crispy slices of raw banana are deep-fried, often in coconut oil. They are a common homemade and packaged snack with a distinct texture.

name: Too Yumm! Bhuja
description: Marketed as a healthier alternative, these baked chips from the Too Yumm! brand offer a savory 'bhuja' or masala flavor without being fried.

name: Bingo! Original Style Salted
description: A simple and classic offering from Bingo!, these potato wafers are a straightforward salted option, providing a satisfying crunch and a light, savory taste.

name: Cadbury Dairy Milk
description: An iconic and widely popular milk chocolate bar that is a household name in India. Its sweet, creamy taste makes it a go-to for daily indulgence and gifting.

name: Nestlé KitKat
description: Known for its unique combination of crispy wafer fingers covered in chocolate. The 'Have a break, have a KitKat' tagline is well-recognized in the country.

name: Cadbury 5 Star
description: A popular chocolate bar with a chewy nougat and caramel center. It is known for its sticky, chewy texture and rich taste, making it a classic treat.

name: Nestlé Munch
description: A crunchy, wafer-based chocolate bar that is a favorite among children and adults alike. It is known for its 'Munch, 'Munch' sound and is a popular budget-friendly option.

name: Ferrero Rocher
description: A premium chocolate known for its golden packaging and unique layered texture with a whole hazelnut, a creamy filling, and a crispy wafer shell, perfect for gifting.

name: Sunfeast Dark Fantasy Choco Fills
description: A popular cookie that offers a 'dessert-like' experience with its crunchy shell and a soft, molten chocolate center. It is a go-to choice for a quick indulgence.

name: Britannia Good Day
description: One of India's most loved cookie brands, known for its buttery taste and a variety of inclusions like chocolate chips and nuts. It's a classic tea-time snack.

name: Cadbury Chocobakes Choco Chip Cookies
description: A cookie brand from Cadbury that appeals to chocolate lovers. It combines the classic choco-chip cookie with the rich flavor of Cadbury chocolate.

name: Parle Hide & Seek
description: A premium chocolate chip cookie from Parle, known for its rich cocoa flavor and visible choco-chips. It's a widely available and popular choice for a sweet treat.

name: Britannia NutriChoice Digestive
description: A brand focused on healthier snacking, these biscuits are rich in fiber and made with whole wheat, making them a popular choice for health-conscious consumers.

name: Parle-G
description: An undisputed leader and an iconic biscuit brand in India. Known for its affordability and glucose content, it is a staple in every Indian household and a common pairing with tea.

name: Britannia Marie Gold
description: A light and crispy biscuit that is a quintessential tea-time companion. Its simple, slightly sweet flavor makes it perfect for dipping in hot beverages.

name: Monaco
description: A popular salty biscuit from Parle. Its light, crispy, and savory taste is a refreshing change from sweet biscuits, making it a favorite for snacking.

name: Oreo
description: A globally famous chocolate sandwich cookie with a creamy filling. The 'Twist, Lick, Dunk' ritual has made it a favorite among kids and adults in India.

name: Britannia Bourbon
description: A classic chocolate-flavored cream biscuit with a rich chocolate filling. Its distinct rectangular shape and unique taste have made it a favorite for generations.

name: Lijjat Urad Papad
description: An iconic and widely consumed papad made from urad dal flour. It is known for its light, crispy texture and can be roasted or fried, making it a perfect accompaniment to a meal.

name: Moong Papad
description: A light and crispy papad made from moong dal flour. It is often milder in flavor than urad papad and is a popular choice for a side dish with rice and dal.

name: Aloo Papad
description: A classic homemade-style papad made from mashed potatoes and spices. It puffs up beautifully when fried, offering a light and flavorful crispy snack, especially popular during festive seasons.

name: Sabudana Papad
description: Made from sabudana (tapioca pearls), this papad is a staple during fasting periods like Navaratri. It has a unique, bubbly texture and a simple, subtle taste.

name: Wheel Fryums
description: A popular fryum with a distinct wheel-like shape. These are made from a mix of wheat, corn, and other flours, and puff up into a crunchy, light snack when fried.

name: Finger Fryums
description: Long, tubular-shaped fryums that are a childhood favorite. They have a satisfying crunch and are often found in assorted colorful packs, flavored with masala.

name: Ring Fryums
description: Simple ring-shaped fryums that are easy to eat and fun for kids. They are a classic snack, often seasoned with salt and chili powder after frying.

name: Alphabet Fryums
description: A playful and colorful fryum shaped like alphabets, often a popular snack for children. They are typically made from a wheat-based dough and are light and crispy when fried.

name: Rice Papad (Khichiya)
description: A specialty from North and Western India, this papad is made from rice flour. It is thin, light, and becomes extremely crispy upon frying or roasting, often used for 'masala papad'.

name: Masala Papad
description: This is a variant of the traditional papad, typically Urad or Moong, which is topped with chopped onions, tomatoes, coriander, and spices. It is a popular appetizer in restaurants and homes.

name: Kissan Jam
description: A legacy brand in India, Kissan is known for its mixed fruit jam. It's a staple in most households and a go-to for breakfast and snacks.

name: Pintola Peanut Butter
description: A very popular and trusted brand, Pintola offers a range of all-natural and high-protein peanut butters, catering to a health-conscious audience.

name: Sundrop Peanut Butter
description: A legacy brand in India's food sector, Sundrop is known for its creamy and crunchy peanut butter, making it a household name for decades.

name: Myfitness Peanut Butter
description: Gained massive popularity for its unique and delicious chocolate-flavored peanut butter, appealing to a younger demographic and fitness enthusiasts.

name: Maggi Ketchup
description: A market leader in India, Maggi's tomato ketchup is known for its balanced sweet and tangy flavor. It is a very common dip for Indian snacks and meals.

name: Kissan Ketchup
description: Kissan is another leading ketchup brand, famous for its 'sweet and sour' taste. It is widely used in Indian households and fast-food eateries.

name: Heinz Ketchup
description: A globally recognized brand, Heinz ketchup is popular in India for its rich tomato flavor and thick texture, often found in restaurants and homes.

name: Veeba Ketchup
description: A relatively newer brand that has quickly gained popularity for its wide range of sauces and dips. Veeba's ketchup is known for its quality and taste.

name: Del Monte Ketchup

description: A very popular and modern room freshener brand. It comes in a wide range of formats like aer spray, aer matic, and aer twist, offering a variety of long-lasting fragrances.

name: Odonil
description: A legacy brand for air fresheners in India. Odonil is a trusted name that offers a variety of products, including blocks and sprays, known for their strong and effective fragrances.

name: Ambi Pur
description: A well-known global brand that has a strong presence in India. Ambi Pur is popular for its car air fresheners and home sprays, known for eliminating tough odors and providing a fresh scent.

name: Airwick
description: Airwick is a well-established brand for air fresheners, offering a range of products from sprays to automatic diffusers. It is known for its high-quality fragrances and long-lasting effects.

name: Odonil Zipper
description: A popular variant of the Odonil brand, the 'Zipper' is a small, easy-to-use air freshener that can be hung in bathrooms or cupboards. It is a common choice for smaller spaces that need a quick fragrance boost.

name: Good knight Activ+
description: The most widely used mosquito repellent machine and refill brand in India. It is a staple in almost every household and is known for its dual-mode feature and effectiveness in repelling mosquitoes.

name: All Out All Night
description: A strong competitor to Good knight, All Out is a popular brand known for its consistent performance throughout the night. It is a trusted name for providing uninterrupted protection from mosquitoes.

name: Mortein Powergard
description: Mortein is a well-known brand for pest control. Its liquid vaporizer is a popular choice for its powerful formula that is designed to repel mosquitoes quickly and effectively.

name: Maxo
description: Maxo is an affordable and widely available brand in the repellent segment. Its machine and refills are a common choice for daily mosquito protection.

name: Mosquito Repellent Coil
description: While not a machine, the repellent coil is a traditional and highly popular form of mosquito repellent in India. Brands like Good knight and Maxo offer these coils, which are a very affordable option for continuous protection.

name: Mortein Instamosquito
description: Mortein's spray is a very popular choice for its quick action. It is a go-to for killing mosquitoes and other flying insects instantly, making it ideal for immediate relief.

name: All Out Mosquito Spray
description: All Out's spray provides quick and effective protection against mosquitoes. It is a common household product used to clear rooms of insects before sleeping.

name: Good knight Xpress
description: Known for its 'Xpress' fast-action formula, this spray is designed to quickly knock down and kill mosquitoes. It is a popular and reliable choice for instant pest control.

name: Odomos Herbal
description: Odomos is primarily known for its repellent creams, but its spray variant is also popular for on-the-go protection. It's often chosen for its long-lasting and safe-on-skin formula.

name: Aer Mosquito Repellent
description: From the well-known brand Godrej, Aer offers a mosquito repellent spray that combines a pleasant fragrance with effective pest control, making it a good choice for modern homes.

name: Odomos Mosquito Repellent
description: The most widely used personal mosquito repellent in India. Odomos is trusted for its non-sticky gel and cream formula that provides long-lasting protection from mosquito bites without being harsh on the skin.

name: Good knight Fabric Roll-On
description: A very popular and innovative product that is applied to clothes and not the skin. It is a go-to for parents to protect their children from mosquito bites, known for its long-lasting effect.

name: Mortein Mosquito Repellent Roll-On
description: Mortein's roll-on repellent is a common choice for its convenient application and effective protection against mosquitoes, especially during outdoor activities.

name: Mosquito Repellent Patch
description: A popular choice for kids, these patches are infused with natural oils like citronella. They are a convenient and safe way to keep mosquitoes away without applying anything directly to the skin.

name: Jungle Formula
description: While not as common as Odomos, Jungle Formula is a very popular international brand. Its gel and lotion are chosen for their strong and long-lasting protection, especially in high-risk areas.

name: Lizol Disinfectant Liquid
description: The most trusted and widely used disinfectant for floors and surfaces in India. It is known for its ability to kill 99.9% of germs and is available in a variety of fragrances.

name: Dettol Antiseptic Liquid
description: A classic and iconic antiseptic liquid used for personal hygiene and surface disinfection. It's a staple in every Indian medicine cabinet and is also used for cleaning floors and surfaces to kill germs.

name: Domex Disinfectant Floor Cleaner
description: Domex is a popular choice for disinfecting floors and bathrooms. Its formula is designed to provide powerful germ-killing action and is a strong competitor in the hygiene market.

name: Savlon Disinfectant Liquid
description: Savlon is a well-known antiseptic brand, and its disinfectant liquid is a common choice for its gentle yet effective formula. It is used for first aid and for disinfecting surfaces.

name: Phenyl
description: A traditional and very common disinfectant, especially in older Indian households. It is a concentrated liquid with a strong smell, used for cleaning and disinfecting floors and drains.
